input_data: A dataset containing argumentative essays written by U.S. students in grades 6-12, annotated for discourse elements and their effectiveness ratings.

data file description.train.csv: Contains the annotated discourse elements for all essays in the test set.
data file description.test.csv: Annotations for the test set essays, containing all fields of train.csv except the target, discourse_effectiveness.
data file description.sample_submission.csv: A sample submission file in the correct format.
data file description.train/: A folder containing full-text essays for training.
data file description.test/: A folder containing example essays from the test set.

output_data: Predicted probabilities for each discourse element belonging to the effectiveness ratings: Ineffective, Adequate, Effective.
task: Classify argumentative elements in student writing
name: Argumentative Writing Classification

data file description.jigsaw-toxic-comment-train.csv: Data from the first competition containing English comments from Wikipedia’s talk page edits.
data file description.jigsaw-unintended-bias-train.csv: Data from the second competition, an expanded version of the Civil Comments dataset with additional labels.
data file description.sample_submission.csv: A sample submission file in the correct format for predictions.
data file description.test.csv: Comments from Wikipedia talk pages in different non-English languages.

input_data: The input data consists of English comments from previous competitions and non-English comments from Wikipedia talk pages.
task: Build multilingual models to classify toxicity in online comments
output_data: The output data is a probability score indicating the likelihood that a comment is toxic, with values ranging from 0.0 (non-toxic) to 1.0 (toxic).
name: Toxic Comment Classification Challenge

data file description.train.csv: data to train the model, contains: ID, Title, Domain.
data file description.test.csv: data to predict, contains: ID, Title.
data file description.submission_file01.csv: sample submission with the correct format.

name: Query Domain Classification
output_data: Predicted domain labels for the input queries.
input_data: A collection of text sentences labeled with their corresponding query domains, compiled from various sources including web search logs and online forums.
